Welcome from our headteacher James Ellis
Welcome to Warren Road Primary School and our website which contains a wide range of information about us including recent news and achievements, upcoming events and our future plans.
The school is set on extensive grounds on the edge of Orpington in the London Borough of Bromley. As a large primary school, we benefit from great wealth and depth of talent across our pupils, parents, staff and governors. As a result, we believe we can provide the very best opportunities for every single child in the school through our vision of Excellence for All.
Our Vision & Values
We pride ourselves in providing an environment that nurtures and supports all children so they have the very best opportunities to REACH their academic and all round potential. The highest priority is given to academic excellence through a curriculum that ensures all children can excel in all areas through high-quality teaching.

EYFS Starters
Reception New Entrants for September
Welcome to Warren Road Primary School. We are extremely proud of our school and we are really looking forward to meeting you all. In the meantime, we have created this webpage for you and hope that you will find it useful. There are a number of videos and documents on this page to help you and your child get to know the school and meet the staff. We will keep updating and adding information over the next few months.
Should you want to get in touch with us please email us at office@warrenroad.bromley.sch.uk
If you would like to find out more details about the starting school procedures, staff, environment, curriculum and much, much more, please read our New Starters Booklet which you will also find on this webpage.
Meanwhile, stay safe and we hope to see and hear from you soon.
Introduction to our school and the reception area
Download our New Starters Booklet
Explore your child’s transition into Warren Road Primary further…
Thank you for taking the time to visit our EYFS Transition Hub. We hope that the information above has been useful. To aid with the transition process further, we have created several sections below which hold more information on the various aspects of starting school at Warren Road Primary. As always, if there is something which you cannot find any information on within this page, then please click here to contact our school office. Please click on a heading, below, for more information.
EYFS indoor and outdoor facilities Videos
Within this section, you can view our EYFS indoor and outdoor facilities. Please click on any of the images to view our videos.
Useful Information and Document Downloads for EYFS Parents
Below, you will find a range of different documents, leaflets and booklets that will provide useful tips and strategies for the transition between nursery and reception. We will constantly be adding to this area, so please check back every now and then.

Purchasing of Warren Road Primary School Uniform and PE Accessories
Please find information about the uniform at Warren Road Primary to the right. We have 3 sets of uniforms at school. A set for winter, summer and PE. Our winter and summer uniforms can be purchased from Graduates in Orpington High Street.
However, we do have a nearly new shed that is run by our PTA which is located in the main playground. The opening times for this will be made available once the new term has started.
View our different uniform picturesUniform requirement list
SEND Support and Information at Warren Road Primary
We have an amazing SEND team based on-site at Warren Road Primary. This is led by Mrs Gemma Read and she is available before you start if you have any concerns or require more information.
You can contact Mrs Read by emailing office@warrenroad.bromley.sch.uk
You can also find out more information about SEND at WRPS here.
The PTA at Warren Road Primary
We are very fortunate at Warren Road, to have such a wonderful and committed PTA. They put on a wide range of events ranging from film night, discos and fireworks evenings to Holi paint runs. Their amazing efforts go toward funding some fantastic facilities and equipment that every child at the school benefits from.
If you would like to read more information about how the PTA helps our school, or if you would like to join when your child starts in September, then please click on the button, below, to view our PTA hub on our website.

Sports and PE Premium
What is Warren Road Primary PE and Sports Premium?
The Premium is designed to help children get an active start in life, supporting primary schools to improve the quality of their PE and sport provision so that pupils experience the benefits of regular exercise – from becoming healthier both mentally and physically to improved behaviour and better academic achievement. The funding is a ring-fenced grant for English primary schools to provide additional and sustainable improvements to the quality of PE, sport and physical activity. Allocations to schools are determined by a formula based on pupil numbers.
We are delighted that the Department for Education has confirmed that the investment for the next academic year (2020-2021) is £320 million. The government’s commitment since 2013 has demonstrated the significance of Physical Education and School Sport.
Education Secretary, Gavin Williamson, said:
During these challenging times, it has become clearer to me than ever the importance of keeping active and how it benefits not just our physical health but also our ability to pay attention, our mood and our mental health too.
Every family will have had a different experience of the pandemic, and I know that many children will have missed time spent outdoors with their friends – that’s why it’s so important that ahead of a full return to school in September, schools get the certainty they need to prepare their PE and sports activities for next year
The WRPS sport's vision
At Warren Road Primary School, we aim to establish a sporting culture that enables and encourages all children to play and enjoy a wide range of sporting pursuits. We believe that it is essential for all children to have the opportunity to develop key knowledge, skills and understanding within a range of different areas as well as recognising the importance of enjoyment of an active healthy lifestyle. We also recognise the significance of competitive sport as to our pupils’ wider educational development and in preparing them for their secondary education and later life.
At Warren Road we aim to improve
1. Improve the quality of the school P.E. programme by:
2. Establish a wide-ranging extra-curricular sports programme
3. Provide additional training and coaching for children within school teams to develop their skills as part of our gifted and talented offer
4. Enter teams into a wide range of borough festivals and competitions
5. Create inter-school sport competitions to provide further competitive opportunities
6. Ensure children are confident swimmers and that when they leave Warren Road, they can all swim 50 metres and use a range of different strokes as well as develop essential life-saving and first aid skills
7. Ensure children are aware of the benefits of Physical Education and how it contributes to their physical; emotional; personal; social; moral; cultural and spiritual well-being
8. Provide ongoing monitoring and evaluation of the pupil entitlement

About the WRPS PTA
The Warren Road Primary School PTA
Over the last few years, the PTA has raised in excess of £25,000 per year from a wide range of activities. The main fundraising events are Summer Fair, Christmas Fair and Fireworks. Other smaller events include Quiz Nights, Easter events (this year including Orienteering), circus, discos & Film Nights. They raise significant additional funds. Smaller amounts are raised from activities such as the sale of second-hand uniforms, personalised cards & ice lollies.
These funds are then donated to the school for various purposes. One of the original reasons for establishing the PTA was to fund the school swimming pool and we have continued to fund maintenance as part of our ongoing commitment to the project, providing KS2 students with the opportunity to use the facility weekly.
Annually the PTA funds the school Crossing Patrol Guard, Listening Ear, Life Space and books & resources for each classroom. Many years ago, we agreed to provide funding towards the Year 6 Isle of Wight trip and continue to do so in the form of baseball caps for each child.
In addition to the regular payments in the last few years, the PTA have funded several one-off purchases and expenditures. In 23/24 - £37,000 was donated to the Playground Project and previous projects have included the library.
We hold regular meetings at school, liaising with the Senior Leadership Team to agree on funding for projects as well as planning and organising our events. We are always keen to encourage people to join the team, volunteer at events or bring new ideas for thought to us.

Warren Road PTA Trustees
Bianca Haupt Erasmus: PTA Chair
Hi, I’m Bianca, I am the proud mamma of three children, 13-, 10- and 5 years old. I joined the PTA in 2013 – my first event was to help host a Spring Spectacular/Pamper evening in March 2014, where I got a paraffin wax and thought my feet had gone to heaven! Through the years, I have helped on almost all of our PTA events and have been lead on Film night for a couple of years and since 2016 have led the Fireworks event. This will be my second year as Chair to the PTA and I’m very excited to see what new interesting events we can host for the children of the Warren Road family.
The PTA consists of a lot of people from a big variety of backgrounds, but all united in supporting our children and school and bringing to life fun, educational and uplifting events for our children to enjoy. I love that this enables us to financially support our teachers in doing the heroic work they do every day. And it really is so much fun, too!
Laura West: Treasurer
I’m Laura West. I have two sons at Warren Road. I first volunteered for film night in 2018.I have been the treasurer of the PTA for the last few years. I find being part of the PTA a rewarding experience and enjoy meeting other parents and carers who volunteer for events.
Jenny Cottle: General Secretary
I am Jenny Cottle, I have 2 children at Warren Road. I attended my first PTA meeting in September 2019 and volunteered at Fireworks the same year. I became General Secretary of the PTA in January 2021 and regularly attend and volunteer at events across the calendar. Being part of the PTA community helping to raise funds for our school and contribute toward making our school the best environment it can be, is an incredibly rewarding experience. I am blown away by the generosity and support of the parents/carers at Warren Road and the skills and drive of my fellow PTA members and volunteers.
Donna Lam: Christmas Fair Lead
I’m Donna Lam, mum of 3 children at Warren Road and I’ve been part of the PTA since my eldest son started Reception in 2017. I enjoy helping out at events and being part of the school community, making a difference to the children’s well-being and education. I am currently the Christmas fair lead and look after the Nearly New Uniform Shed.
Lauren Purdy
Hi everyone, my name is Lauren. I have 2 daughters currently at Warren Road, 1 in year 2 and the other in year 6.
I started to get involved with the PTA back in 2018. Having attended events when my eldest daughter was in Reception, I was amazed at the fantastic atmosphere surrounding the various events and wanted to help. Once I’d taken those first steps, I was hooked. The amazing teams that put together these fantastic and engaging events made me feel welcome and valued. I’ve relished the opportunity to share in the success of the PTA at bringing fun events to Warren Road and enhancing the school with the funds raised. I hope to get to meet many more fantastic Warren Road parents at PTA events this year.
Vicky Wood
Hi, I’m Vicky, I have 3 children at Warren Road in years 5, 2 and reception and have been involved in the PTA for the last 5 years. I have enjoyed helping at and organising various events over the last few years and became Deputy Chair in November 2023. It’s been great to get to know other parents and teachers through the events we run and it’s exciting to be making a real difference to the children’s school experience with the funds we raise!

PTA Projects
Warren Road Primary PTA Projects
Playground Equipment and Playground Project
In May 2021 the PTA approved the funding of new wooden play equipment in the main and infant playground to replace some of the previous equipment. This has proved very popular with the children.
In 2023/24, the PTA committed to fundraising for the Playground Project. It was agreed that all profits from the events and sales would be dedicated to this. The PTA were involved with planning the layout of areas, as we all the design of a new outdoor shelter which is located outside the PTA Uniform Shed. This area now serves as an outdoor learning space, as well as provide shelter for the children during warm and wet seasons, whilst also providing a covered area for PTA sales of lollies or uniform along with a great base for the BBQ & Bar at the Fireworks and other events.
Staff Room Renovation
The staffroom underwent a much-needed revamp in the 2022/23 school year. Previously, the space did not function effectively as both a working and relaxing environment.
The newly redesigned staffroom now features clearly defined zones: a dedicated workspace equipped with desks, and a separate area designed for relaxation and socialising. This improvement has created a more functional and supportive environment for staff well-being and productivity.
The Swimming Pool
Back in the 1980′s, The PTA commissioned the Warren Road swimming pool. Since this time thousands of Children have used the pool, both for fun and learning. The PTA continue to maintain this pool for all Children of all ages to enjoy.
Each week, every one of our KS2 children receives a swimming lesson from our qualified swimming teachers.
The children learn all strokes including, freestyle, breaststroke, backstroke and butterfly. This helps them become competent swimmers by the time they leave Warren Road.
The swimming pool is also hired out to local companies, with the revenue going directly back into school funds.
Art/Therapy Room Renovation
In 2022/23, the Art/Therapy Room underwent a renovation, including the addition of new furniture and a broad selection of art materials and equipment. The space has been thoughtfully designed to support children's creativity, emotional expression, and wellbeing. It is now a welcoming and flexible environment where pupils can take part in a wide range of art, craft, and therapeutic activities, either individually or in small groups, as part of their broader learning and development.
Library Transformation Project
The school raised the prospect of transforming the school libraries, and plans were developed to refurbish both the junior and infant library spaces. The PTA unanimously voted to support the project in full, committing £20,000 to cover the associated costs.
The PTA recognises the value of nurturing a lifelong love of reading and believes that fun, welcoming library spaces will support this. The refurbished libraries aim to reflect the school’s ethos by encouraging reading for pleasure and inspiring more children to enjoy books.
Holi Celebrations
The PTA has been working to promote greater cultural diversity through activities involving the children. In March 2022 and 2024, several parent helpers and PTA members collaborated with all year groups to create vibrant chalk designs across the playgrounds. As shown in the photo above, the children produced beautiful artwork and thoroughly enjoyed taking part in this inclusive and creative experience.
We are always looking for new ideas and opportunities to reflect and celebrate the diverse backgrounds within our school community—and we warmly welcome parents to come forward, get involved, and help us bring these initiatives to life
